attributes.context: This is Section 17.2, Rights Retained by Management, under Article XVII-Management Rights, which follows Section 17.1, Intent of Agreement, stating that the Agreement is not intended to interfere with, abridge, or limit the Company's right to manage its business and direct its Employees.

extraction_text: The Employer reserves and retains the sole and exclusive right to the Management of the Business, the direction of the working force, including but not limited to the right to plan and direct operations, schedule hours of work, control volume of production, add or drop product lines, establish or continue policies, practices or procedures for the conduct of business, and from time to time, change or abolish such policies, practices or procedures, determine the number, location, or relocation and types of its operation and the methods, processes and materials to be employed, hire, suspend, layoff, discharge for proper cause, transfer or release from duty because of lack of work or other legitimate reasons; study or introduce new production methods or facilities, maintain rules and regulations covering Employees and retain all the rights that are customarily considered Management functions and which the Employer may determine to be necessary for the orderly, safe, efficient and profitable conduct of its business and its operations covered hereunder.
